Expense.label: Project Expense
Expense.description: Cost charged to a project — labour, materials, travel, subcontractor fees, or overhead allocation.

641.detail: Salary account (641) posted directly to project — should route via Payroll Posting Profile allocation, not direct charge.

512.detail: Bank account used as credit offset for an expense — verify this is not a duplicate of an already-posted AP or payroll entry.

Revenue.label: Project Revenue
Revenue.description: Revenue recognition or direct billing on a project — milestone invoicing, percentage-of-completion entries, or deferred revenue release.

entries.label: Trade Receivables / Accrued Revenue / Deferred Revenue Release

419.detail: Customer deposit / advance (419) used instead of trade receivables (411) — review billing workflow.

706.detail: Services revenue account (706) used where product revenue (701) was expected — verify item category setup in project contract.

WIP.label: Work-In-Progress
WIP.description: WIP cost accumulation or recognition — staging project costs on the balance sheet before revenue recognition criteria are met.

entries.label: WIP Asset / Accrued Revenue / Deferred Revenue Release
Revenue / Change in Production / WIP Reduction

35.detail: Finished goods account (35x) used for WIP — check project category determines WIP vs. finished-goods classification.

CostAccrual.label: Project Cost Accrual (Auto-Reversal)
CostAccrual.description: Project Group cost accrual with automatic reversal. D365 posts a forward entry (DR P&L / CR BS accrual account) and an immediate or period-start reversal (DR BS / CR P&L) to neutralize the P&L impact. The BS accrual account acts as a transitory holding account.

entries.label: Accrued cost — BS holding account (forward accrual)

52000.detail: Miscellaneous financial account (52000) used as BS accrual account instead of dedicated project accrual account (4871/487). The Project Posting Profile 'Accrued cost' field is incorrectly configured.

401.detail: Trade payable account (401) used for project cost accrual instead of a dedicated BS accrual account. Trade payable is reserved for vendor invoice postings, not for Project Group accruals.

486.detail: Prepaid expense account (486) used as accrual BS account instead of 487/4871. The accrual is a liability (charge à payer), not a prepayment.

RevenueAccrual.label: Project Revenue Accrual (Auto-Reversal)
RevenueAccrual.description: Project Group revenue accrual with automatic reversal. D365 posts a forward revenue accrual (DR BS / CR Revenue) and an immediate reversal (DR Revenue / CR BS) when the Project Group accrual principle is active. Net P&L effect is zero; revenue is recognized only on final billing.

entries.label: Accrued revenue — BS holding account (forward accrual)

411.detail: Trade receivables account (411) used as BS accrual account for revenue accrual. This account is reserved for billed invoices. The Project Posting Profile 'Accrued revenue-sales value' field should reference 418 or 4871.

487.detail: Deferred income account (487) used for revenue accrual instead of the unbilled receivables / accrued revenue account (418/4871). Review project billing and revenue recognition setup.
